tool.name: G_NEQ joint-signature calibration
tool.abstraction: After source-justified normalization of the G_NEQ canonical covering pairs to common partitions, encode each diagonal witness by its membership signature; covering all canonical unequal-pair filters is equivalent to injectivity of these signatures.
preconditions: target is the G_NEQ canonical semi-filter calibration from Cavalar-Oliveira Proposition 40
Claim 41 applies to the singleton complement fibres
Lemmas 42-43 justify replacing each relevant pair by a partition without losing canonical coverage
structural_signature: one common integral family of binary partitions
conditional full-semi-filter source-definition regression for a fixed normalized G_NEQ family
tool.operation: map each diagonal witness to its joint membership signature under the normalized pair family; require injectivity and use N<=2^k as the exact canonical calibration floor
guaranteed_effects: detects whether a proposed joint-consistency repair recovers the exact log2 N canonical G_NEQ benchmark
distinguishes C024-style independence failure from a later representation-scope failure
conditional on a fixed normalized G_NEQ partition family, verifies that signature injectivity agrees with coverage of every full semi-filter above every unequal edge
non_guarantees: does not normalize arbitrary full semi-filters
does not extend Claim 41/Lemmas 42-43 partition normalization from canonical coverage to arbitrary full semi-filter cover pairs
does not bound every mathematical function of a signature matrix
does not produce a super-log full-cover lower bound
does not establish novelty or P versus NP
validation_obligations: bind every normalization step to Claim 41/Lemmas 42-43 and the G_NEQ canonical family
verify the induced signatures are injective exactly when all canonical F_(u,v) are covered
after passing calibration, check whether the retained state has any noncanonical full-semi-filter content before target evaluation
when executable, enumerate full semi-filters directly rather than checking only the compact signature implementation

identity_reconciliation.parallel_id_disposition: NOT_MINTED; stronger executable assurance assimilated into the canonical scoped tool
